jobs.title: Embedded Security Engineer (Automotive Cybersecurity)
jobs.description: Embedded Security Engineer (Automotive Cybersecurity) Position: Embedded Security Engineer Location: Coimbatore Experience: 5-8 Years About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled Embedded Security Engineer to support the development and integration of cybersecurity solutions for the Cockpit Integration Platform (CIP) in next-generation automotive systems. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and validating security mechanisms across AUTOSAR, QNX, Android, and Linux platforms while ensuring compliance with automotive cybersecurity standards such as ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R155 . The role requires expertise in embedded security architecture, cryptography, hardware security, secure software development, threat analysis, and vulnerability management for automotive products. Key Responsibilities · Analyze customer requirements and specifications to identify, derive, and maintain cybersecurity requirements at the Cockpit Integration Platform (CIP) level. · Design and develop embedded security solutions based on customer and product cybersecurity requirements. · Define and implement cybersecurity concepts and controls including: o Secure Boot o Secure Flashing o Secure Diagnostics o Secure Software Updates o Access Control Mechanisms o Firewall Configuration o Secure Communication Protocols · Support integration and configuration of security features across AUTOSAR, QNX, Android, and Linux-based platforms. · Work closely with hardware and platform teams for HSM (Hardware Security Module) and TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) integration. · Implement cryptographic solutions using AES, RSA, ECC, SHA/HMAC, Digital Signatures, and PKI infrastructure. · Perform threat modeling, risk analysis, cybersecurity impact assessments, and vulnerability management activities. · Conduct security reviews and ensure compliance with secure coding standards such as MISRA and CERT C/C++. · Collaborate with software, system, architecture, and validation teams to ensure end-to-end cybersecurity compliance. · Support cybersecurity verification and validation activities including penetration testing and security assessments. · Contribute to cybersecurity work products required by ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R155 regulations. · Follow Agile/SAFe development methodologies and ASPICE-compliant development processes. · Participate in design reviews, security audits, and technical discussions with customers and stakeholders. Mandatory Skills Embedded Security Development · Strong experience in designing and developing security mechanisms in: o AUTOSAR o QNX o Android o Embedded Linux Automotive Cybersecurity · Hands-on experience with: o Secure Boot o Secure Flashing o Secure Diagnostics o Access Control o Secure Compiler Usage o Firewall Configuration o Secure OTA Concepts Hardware Security · Strong understanding of: o Hardware Security Modules (HSM) o Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) o Secure Key Storage o Hardware-based Cryptographic Operations Secure
